title: Iowa coach Kirk Ferentz expresses support for former Hawkeyes LB Jack Campbell

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Iowa coach Kirk Ferentz expresses support for former Hawkeyes LB Jack Campbell
sources.description: Anyone who follows football and who cares about the men who play the game remains deeply concerned about the health and well-being of Lions linebacker Jack Campbell, who remains hospitalized after suffering a neck injury during Sunday's game against the Vikings.
